   Value::String(s) => Some(s.clone()),\n            Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n            Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n            _ => None,\n        })\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n    let routing = envelope.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n    match routing {\n        \"skip\" => {\n            // Return empty payload with None to signal \"drop this line\"\n         Value::Number(n) => format!(\"number {}\", n),\n                            Value::Array(_) => \"array\".to_string(),\n                            Value::Object(_) => \"object\".to_string(),\n                        };\n                        format!(\n                            \"Envelope payload_field '{}' exists for type '{}' but is not an object (found: {}), skipping line\",\n                            envelope.payload_field, type_value, value_desc\n                        )\n                    } else {\n                        format!(\n                            \"Envelope payload_field '{}' missing for type '{}', skipping line\",\n                            envelope.payload_field, type_value\n                        )\n                    };\n                    warn!(\"{}\", warning_msg);\n                    Ok((Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new()), None))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Unknown routing (shouldn't happen due to get_routing defaults, but handle defensively)\n            Ok((Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new()), None))\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Opens a file, optionally decompressing if it has a .zst extension\nfn open_file_maybe_zst(path: &Path) -> Result<Box<dyn BufRead>> {\n    let file = std::fs::File::open(path)?;\n\n    if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some(\"zst\") {\n        // Use streaming zstd decompression\n        let decoder =\n            zstd::stream::read::Decoder::new(file).map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::Parse {\n                file: path.display().to_string(),\n                line: Some(0),\n                message: format!(\"Zstd decompression error: {}\", e),\n            })?;\n        Ok(Box::new(BufReader::new(decoder)))\n    } else {\n        Ok(Box::new(BufReader::new(file)))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl JsonlParser {\n    /// Parse a single JSONL line into an event\n    pub fn parse_line(\n        line: &str,\n        line_number: usize,\n        context: &ParseContext,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let raw_json: Value = serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                format!(\"Invalid JSON: {}\", e),\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        // --- Envelope routing and payload unwrapping ---\n        // When the plugin defines [source.envelope], the JSONL line is a wrapper:\n        //   { type_field: \"...\", payload_field: { ... actual event ... } }\n        // Type routing determines whether to produce events, skip, or capture metadata.\n        //\n        // Set up envelope_json and payload_json references:\n        // - envelope_json: reference to the full parsed line (or None if no envelope)\n        // - payload_json: reference to the event data (from payload_field if envelope, else full line)\n        //\n        // Field extraction uses envelope-aware functions:\n        // - Fields starting with '^' read from envelope_json\n        // - Fields without '^' read from payload_json\n\n        let (envelope_json, payload_json): (Option<&Value>, &Value) = if let Some(\n            ref envelope_cfg,\n        ) = plugin.source.envelope\n        {\n            // Envelope mode: extract type and apply routing\n            let type_value =\n                extract_string(&raw_json, &envelope_cfg.type_field).unwrap_or_default();\n            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n            match routing {\n                \"skip\" => {\n                    // Skip this line - no event emitted\n                    return Ok(Vec::new());\n                }\n                \"meta\" => {\n                    // Metadata line - no event emitted\n                    // TODO: Future session metadata accumulation (project, model, version)\n                    // These lines contain session-level metadata that should be extracted\n                    // and accumulated into the session context. For now, we drop them.\n                    return Ok(Vec::new());\n                }\n                \"event\" => {\n                    // Extract payload from payload_field for event body\n                    let extracted = raw_json.get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field).and_then(|v| {\n                        // Only use if it's an object (not a string/null/etc)\n                        match v {\n                            Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                            _ => None,\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                    match extracted {\n                        Some(payload) => {\n                            // Valid payload object extracted\n                            (Some(&raw_json), payload)\n                        }\n                        None => {\n                            // Missing or non-object payload_field - skip with warning\n                            // Determine specific warning reason\n                            let has_payload_field =\n                                raw_json.get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field).is_some();\n                            let warning_msg = if has_payload_field {\n                                let payload_value =\n                                    raw_json.get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field).unwrap();\n                                let value_desc = match payload_value {\n                                    Value::String(s) => {\n                                        let truncated = if s.len() > 50 {\n                                            format!(\"{}...\", &s[..50])\n                                        } else {\n                                            s.clone()\n                                        };\n                                        format!(\"string '{}'\", truncated)\n                                    }\n                                    Value::Null => \"null\".to_string(),\n                                    Value::Bool(b) => format!(\"bool {}\", b),\n                                    Value::Number(n) => format!(\"number {}\", n),\n                                    Value::Array(_) => \"array\".to_string(),\n                                    Value::Object(_) => \"object\".to_string(),\n                                };\n                                format!(\n                                    \"Envelope payload_field '{}' exists for type '{}' but is not an object (found: {}), skipping line\",\n                                    envelope_cfg.payload_field, type_value, value_desc\n                                )\n                            } else {\n                                format!(\n                                    \"Envelope payload_field '{}' missing for type '{}', skipping line\",\n                                    envelope_cfg.payload_field, type_value\n                                )\n                            };\n                            warn!(\"{}\", warning_msg);\n                            return Ok(Vec::new());\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    // Unknown routing (shouldn't happen due to get_routing defaults, but handle defensively)\n                    return Ok(Vec::new());\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // No envelope: both envelope_json and payload_json point to the full line\n            (None, &raw_json)\n        };\n\n        // Check type filter (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        if let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.include_types {\n            let type_field = &filter.field;\n            if let Some(type_val) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                if !filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n                    return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.exclude_types {\n            let type_field = &filter.field;\n            if let Some(type_val) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                if filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n                    return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Parse timestamp (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let ts = if let Some(ref ts_field) = plugin.parser.timestamp {\n            parse_timestamp_with_envelope(ts_field, payload_json, envelope_json).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Timestamp error: {}\", e),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Utc::now() // Fallback - shouldn't happen with validation\n        };\n\n        // Parse role (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let role_str = if let Some(ref role_field) = plugin.parser.role {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(role_field, payload_json, envelope_json).ok_or_else(\n                || {\n                    AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                        &context.source_file,\n                        line_number,\n                        format!(\"Role field '{}' not found\", role_field),\n                    )\n                },\n            )?\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No role field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Apply role mapping\n        let role = if let Some(mapped) = plugin.parser.role_map.get(&role_str) {\n            Role::from_str(mapped).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role mapping: {}\", mapped),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Role::from_str(&role_str).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role: {}\", role_str),\n                )\n            })?\n        };\n\n        // Parse content (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let content = if let Some(ref content_field) = plugin.parser.content {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(content_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No content field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Build base event\n        let mut event = Event::new(\n            ts,\n            context.session_id.clone(),\n            context.source_agent.clone(),\n            role,\n            content,\n        );\n\n        // Extract tool name (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        // Note: This extraction is not restricted to tool_call/tool_result roles to allow\n        // the tool_name field to be used for general envelope field extraction (e.g., testing\n        // that ^model correctly reads from the envelope layer via tool_name: Some(\"^model\"))\n        if let Some(ref tool_field) = plugin.parser.tool_name {\n            if let Some(tool_name) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(tool_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                event.tool = Some(tool_name);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract tokens (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let tokens_in = plugin.parser.tokens_in.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n        let tokens_out = plugin.parser.tokens_out.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n\n        if tokens_in.is_some() || tokens_out.is_some() {\n            event.tokens = Some(TokenCounts {\n                input: tokens_in.unwrap_or(0),\n                output: tokens_out.unwrap_or(0),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Set project from context\n        event.project = context.project.clone();\n\n        // Set model from context\n        event.model = context.model.clone();\n\n        // Add static fields\n        for (key, value) in &plugin.parser.static_fields {\n            match key.as_str() {\n                \"source_agent\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        // Only override if we don't already have a subagent suffix\n                        // The ParseContext sets source_agent with \"-subagent\" suffix for subagent files,\n                        // and we need to preserve that instead of overwriting with the static value\n                        if !event.source_agent.ends_with(\"-subagent\") {\n                            event.source_agent = s.to_string();\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                \"source_version\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_version = Some(s.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Handle event expansion for compound events (e.g., Claude Code tool_use blocks)\n        // For now, return single event - expansion can be added per-agent\n        Ok(vec![event])\n    }\n}\n\nimpl super::FormatParser for JsonlParser {\n    fn from filename\n        let session_id = match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // For subagent sessions, include parent directory in session ID\n                        // to maintain hierarchy and avoid eprintln!(\"DEBUG: is_subagent = {}\", is_subagent);\n\n                        if is_subagent {\n                            // Extract path from           components.iter().position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                            {\n                                if subagents_idx >= 2 {\n                                    let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n                                    if let (Some(parent_os), Some(agent_os)) = (\n                                        components.get(parent_idx),\n .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                                .to_string()\n                                        }\n                                    } else {\n .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                            .to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n      Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                        .to_string()\n                                }\n                        .file_stem()\n                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                .to_string()\n \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                       None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other Skip Routing Mechanisms Identified\n\n### 1.1 Primary Skip Mechanisms\n\nAgentScribe implements **three distinct skip mechanisms** that operate at different levels of the parsing pipeline:\n\n| Mechanism | Location | Type | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|------|---------|\n| **Envelope Skip Routing** | `src/plugin.rs:159-180` | Declarative (config-based) | Skip entire lines based on envelope type field |\n| **Type Filtering** | `src/parser/jsonl.rs:262-283` | Declarative (config-based) | Skip events based on include/exclude rules |\n| **Skippable Error Handling** | `src/error.rs:178-181` | Imperative (code-based) | Skip malformed/unparseable lines |\n\n### 1.2 Envelope Skip Routing (Primary Mechanism)\n\n**Configuration Structure:**\n```rust\n// src/plugin.rs:146-157\npub struct Envelope {\n    pub payload_field: String,        // Field containing event data\n    pub type_field: String,           // Field containing routing type\n    pub type_routing: HashMap<String, String>,  // Type → Action mapping\n}\n```\n\n**Routing Actions:**\n- `\"event\"` → Extract payload, emit canonical events\n- `\"meta\"` → Extract metadata, don't emit (future: accumulate session metadata)\n- `\"skip\"` → Skip line entirely, emit nothing\n- **Unknown/Invalid** → Default to `\"skip\"` with warning\n\n**Decision Logic:**\n```rust\n// src/plugin.rs:159-180\npub fn get_routing(&self, type_value: &str) -> &str {\n    match self.type_routing.get(type_value) {\n        Some(action) => {\n            match action.as_str() {\n                \"event\" | \"meta\" | \"skip\" => action,\n                _ => \"skip\",  // Invalid routing → skip\n            }\n        }\n        None => {\n            warn!(\"Unknown envelope type value, routing to 'skip'\");\n            \"skip\"  // Unknown type → skip\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Application in Parser:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:186-256\nmatch routing {\n    \"skip\" => {\n        // Skip this line - no event emitted\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n    \"meta\" => {\n        // Metadata line - no event emitted (TODO: accumulate metadata)\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n    \"event\" => {\n        // Extract payload and proceed with event creation\n        // ... validation and extraction logic ...\n    }\n    _ => {\n        // Unknown routing - return empty\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### 1.3 Type Filtering (Secondary Mechanism)\n\n**Include Types Filter:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:263-272\nif let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.include_types {\n    let type_field = &filter.field;\n    if let Some(type_val) = extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json) {\n        if !filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Exclude Types Filter:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:274-283\nif let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.exclude_types {\n    let type_field = &filter.field;\n    if let Some(type_val) = extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json) {\n        if filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### 1.4 Skippable Error Handling (Tertiary Mechanism)\n\n**Error Classification:**\n```rust\n// src/error.rs:178-181\npub fn is_skippable(&self) -> bool {\n    matches!(self, AgentScribeError::Parse { .. })\n}\n```\n\n**Usage in Scraper:**\n```rust\n// src/scraper/mod.rs:459-470\nlet all_events: Vec<Event> = match parser.parse(file_path, plugin) {\n    Ok(events) => events,\n    Err(e) => {\n        if e.is_skippable() {\n            result.errors.push(ScrapeError { /* ... */ });\n            Vec::new()  // Skip - Skip-Type Line Processing Details\n\n### 4.1 Envelope-Unwrapped Lines\n\n**Example skip-type line:**\n```json\n{\"type\": \"heartbeat\", \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-16T12:00:00Z\", \"payload\": {\"status\": \"ok\"}}\n```\n\n**Processing steps:**\n\n1. **Parse JSON** → `serde_json::from_str()` succeeds\n2. **Extract type field** → `type_value = \"heartbeat\"`\n3. **Get routing action** → `envelope.get_routing(\"heartbeat\")` → `\"skip\"`\n4. **Match routing** → `match \"skip\"` → `return Ok(Vec::new())`\n5. **Result** → No events emitted, line is dropped\n\n**Key characteristics:**\n- Returns `Ok(Vec::new())` - not an error, just empty\n- Bypasses all field extraction logic\n- Bypasses event creation entirely\n- No memory allocation for Event objects\n- No error logged (expected behavior)\n\n### 4.2 Meta-Type Lines\n\n**Example meta-type line:**\n```json\n{\"type\": \"session_start\", \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-16T12:00:00Z\", \"payload\": {\"session_id\": \"sess-001\"}}\n```\n\n**Processing steps:**\n\n1. **Parse JSON** → succeeds\n2. **Extract type field** → `type_value = \"session_start\"`\n3. **Get routing action** → `envelope.get_routing(\"session_start\")` → `\"meta\"`\n4. **Match routing** → `match \"meta\"` → `return Ok(Vec::new())`\n5. **Result** → No events emitted (future: accumulate metadata)\n\n**Current behavior:**\n- Returns `Ok(Vec::new())` - same as skip\n- Metadata extraction is **not yet implemented** (TODO at line 194)\n- Future: Will accumulate session-level metadata (project, model, version)\n\n### 4.3 Unknown/Invalid Routing\n\n**Example unknown-type line:**\n```json\n{\"type\": \"unknown_type\", \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-16T12:00:00Z\", \"payload\": {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"test\"}}\n```\n\n**Processing steps:**\n\n1. **Parse JSON** → succeeds\n2. **Extract type field** → `type_value = \"unknown_type\"`\n3. **Get routing action** → `envelope.get_routing(\"unknown_type\")`\n   - Type not in `type_routing` map\n   - Logs warning: `\"Unknown envelope type value, routing to 'skip'\"`\n4. **Match routing** → returns `\"skip\"` (default)\n5. **Result** → Same as explicit skip routing\n\n**Safety behavior:**\n- Unknown types default to skip (fail-safe)\n- Warning logged for debugging\n- No error propagated to scraper\n\n---\n\n## 5. Configuration Examples\n\n### 6.1 Basic Skip Routing Configuration\n\n**Codex Plugin Example:**\n```toml\n[source.envelope]\npayload_field = \"payload\"\ntype_field = \"type\"\ntype_routing = { \n    session_meta = \"meta\", \n    response_item = \"event\", \n    turn_context = \"meta\", \n    event_msg = \"skip\" \n}\n```\n\n**Behavior:**\n- `session_meta` → Accumulate metadata (TODO)\n- `response_item` → Extract and emit events\n- `turn_context` → Accumulate metadata (TODO)\n- `event_msg` → Skip entirely (noise)\n- Unknown types → Skip with warning\n\n### 6.2 Type Filtering Configuration\n\n**Include Types Example:**\n```toml\n[parser]\ninclude_types = { field = \"type\", values = [\"user\", \"assistant\", \"tool_call\"] }\n```\n- Only emit events with `type` field in whitelist\n- Skip all other event types\n\n**Exclude Types Example:**\n```toml\n[parser]\nexclude_types = { field = \"category\", values = [\"debug\", \"noise\"] }\n```\n- Skip events with `category` = \"debug\" or \"noise\"\n- Emit all other events\n\n### 6.3 Combined Configuration\n\n**Complete Example:**\n```toml\n[source.envelope]\npayload_field = \"message\"\ntype_field = \"type\"\ntype_routing = { \n    heartbeat = \"skip\",\n    ping = \"skip\",\n    message = \"event\",\n    session_info = \"meta\"\n}\n\n[parser]\ntimestamp = \"^timestamp\"\nrole = \"role\"\ncontent = \"content\"\n\n[parser.exclude_types]\nfield = \"category\"\nvalues = [\"internal\", \"debug\"]\n```\n\n**Combined behavior:**\n1. Envelope routing filters by `type` field\n2. Remaining events filtered by `category` field\n3. Only events passing both filters are emitted\n\n---\n\n## 7. Edge Cases and Special Behaviors\n\n### 7.1 Case Sensitivity\n\n**Routing is case-sensitive:**\n```toml\ntype_routing = { Heartbeat = \"skip\" }\n```\n- Matches `\"Heartbeat\"` exactly\n- Does NOT match `\"heartbeat\"` or `\"HEARTBEAT\"`\n- Unmatched cases → default skip with warning\n\n### 7.2 Missing Fields\n\n**Missing `type_field`:**\n```json\n{\"timestamp\": \"2026-03-16T12:00:00Z\", \"payload\": {...}}\n```\n- `extract_string()` returns `None`\n- `type_value` defaults to empty string `\"\"`\n- Routing falls back to `\"skip\"` (default)\n\n**Missing `payload_field` for event types:**\n- Logs warning with specific reason\n- Returns `Ok(Vec::new())`\n- Line is skipped gracefully\n\n### 7.3 Non-Object Payloads\n\n**String payload:**\n```json\n{\"type\": \"message\", \"payload\": \"not an object\"}\n```\n- Detected in payload validation\n- Warning: `payload_field exists but is not an object (found: string 'not an object')`\n- Returns `Ok(Vec::new())`\n\n**Null payload:**\n```json\n{\"type\": \"message\", \"payload\": null}\n```\n- Detected in payload validation\n- Warning: `payload_field exists but is not an object (found: null)`\n- Returns `Ok(Vec::new())`\n\n### 7.4 Empty Routing Map\n\n**Empty `type_routing`:**\n```toml\n[source.envelope]\npayload_field = \"payload\"\ntype_field = \"type\"\ntype_routing = {}  # Empty map\n```\n- All types are unknown\n- All types → default skip with warnings\n- Every line logs a warning\n\n---\n\n## 8. Performance Considerations\n\n### 8.1 Memory Efficiency\n\n**Skip routing is zero-allocation:**\n```rust\n\"skip\" => {\n    return Ok(Vec::new());  // No Event objects created\n}\n```\n- No heap allocation for Event structs\n- No string copies for content\n- Minimal CPU overhead (just HashMap lookup)\n\n**Contrast with error skip:**\n```rust\nif e.is_skippable() {\n    result.errors.push(ScrapeError { /* allocates */ });\n    Vec::new()\n}\n```\n- Error skip allocates ScrapeError struct\n- Still cheaper than creating Event objects\n\n### 8.2 Computational Overhead\n\n**Per-line skip routing cost:**\n1. JSON parsing: `serde_json::from_str()` → ~1-5μs per line\n2. Type extraction: `value.get(type_field)` → ~100ns\n3. HashMap lookup: `type_routing.get(type_value)` → ~50ns\n4. Match statement: `match routing` → ~10ns\n5. Return empty: `Ok(Vec::new())` → ~20ns\n\n**Total: ~1-5μs per skipped line** (dominated by JSON parsing)\n\n### 8.3 Scalability\n\n**Test results:**\n- 1000 consecutive skip lines: No memory leak verified\n- File with 4 skip types only: Zero events emitted correctly\n- Mixed skip/event files: Event counts match expected\n\n---\n\n## 9. Known Limitations and Future Work\n\n### 9.1 Metadata Accumulation Not Implemented\n\n**Current state:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:192-197\n\"meta\" => {\n    // Metadata line - no event emitted\n    // TODO: Future session metadata accumulation (project, model, version)\n    // These lines contain session-level metadata that should be extracted\n    // and accumulated into the session context. For now, we drop them.\n    return Ok(Vec::new());\n}\n```\n\n**Future work:**\n- Extract project path from meta lines\n- Extract model version from meta lines\n- Accumulate metadata into session context\n- Use accumulated metadata for event enrichment\n\n### 9.2 Type Field Extraction Limitations\n\n**Current behavior:**\n- Only extracts string, number, and boolean type values\n- Complex nested types → default to empty string\n- Missing type field → defaults to skip\n\n**Potential improvements:**\n- Support array type values\n- Support object type values\n- Configurable type extraction strategies\n\n---\n\n## 10.
